name: Road Rage

features.name: Three bonus modes
features.description: Morning Rush, H1ghway Jam and City Mayh3m.

features.name: Rage Buff
features.description: Boosts the bonus before it starts.

review:
A traffic jam on a 3-4-3-4-3-4-3 grid where every car is a wild with its own colour-coded effect – the yellow Engine Breakdown car, for example, makes the other symbols bigger.

Three scatters trigger Morning Rush, four H1ghway Jam and five City Mayh3m, and a Rage Buff boosts each bonus before it starts. High volatility, 36,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
